name: day-01-overnight-rest
input: Дэн: Мы снимаем комнаты в трактире и ложимся спать. Утром продолжаем путь.

params.rubric: The transition overnight closes the finished day with advance_day, and the closing summary of that day is produced (deterministically or by the chronicler) in the same turn. The new day starts from the morning.

name: day-02-time-wrap-to-morning
input: Лиса: Мы сидим у костра и ждём до рассвета.

params.rubric: Time is advanced with advance_time; when it wraps past night to morning the DM also starts a new day with advance_day, because the story moved to a new day.

name: day-03-milestone-recorded
input: Дэн: Мы наконец находим тело пропавшего купца на дне колодца.

params.rubric: The major milestone is saved to campaign memory in the same turn — with append_key_event, a campaign summary update, or the chronicler — so it survives context compaction.

name: day-04-session-opener
input: Дэн: Привет! Мы вернулись через неделю. Что нового?

params.rubric: The first turn of a new session starts with get_game_context, opens with a 2-3 sentence recap (where the party is, what they were doing, the active goal) and weaves in 1-2 brief signs that the world moved while the party was away.
